title: Image Squisher
blurb: Shrink, resize and convert a pile of images at once. Everything happens on your device, nothing is uploaded.

title: SFX Maker
blurb: Make retro sound effects for games: coins, jumps, lasers, explosions. Tweak them and save as WAV.

title: Palette Lab
blurb: Build colour palettes, check text contrast, preview colour blindness and export for CSS, Godot or Aseprite.

title: Sprite Sheet Slicer
blurb: Drop in a sprite sheet, cut it into frames and preview the animation. Export the frames or a JSON map.

title: Icon Maker
blurb: One picture in, every icon out: favicon.ico, Apple and Android icons, and the HTML to paste in.

title: QR Maker
blurb: Make QR codes for links, Wi-Fi or plain text, right on your device. No tracking redirects, ever.
